title: Minimality and irreducibility of the one-bit role tag
hypothesis: P1. A content chain of n pairs (k_p, k_(p+1)) with DISTINCT keys; each pair is presented as two ADJACENT tokens (key immediately followed by value); pair order is arbitrary; between pairs any number of zero FILLER tokens may be inserted. P2. Static LTI kernel K(d)=sum_p w_p rho_p^d > 0, fixed deterministic code C with C C^T = I on the key range, query supplied externally. P3. The layer interface is any FIXED (non-learned, content-independent) linear map followed by normalization; all coefficients of the kernel are time-invariant. P4. Available side information per position t is a binary gate w_t in {0,1}; w_t may depend on absolute position t, or on a role tag attached to the input symbol, but NOT on the answer k_H or on the pair permutation in a way that leaks it.
claim: (a) POSITION-ONLY GATES ARE FORMAT PRIORS, NOT ARCHITECTURE. Let w_t = 1[(t-1) even] (the v5 parity mask). If each pair is preceded by f_p filler tokens drawn independently with P(f_p odd) >= 1/2, then for every hop h the indicator w at the unique key-successor position is 1 with probability at most 1/2 and is INDEPENDENT of k_h. Whenever it is 0 the true peak is suppressed and z_h carries no information about k_h; hence expected accuracy <= 1/2 + 1/(2 V_K). (b) ONE BIT IS SUFFICIENT AND FORMAT-INDEPENDENT. Let w_t = 1[role(x_(t-1)) = KEY], where each input symbol carries a deterministic KEY / VALUE / FILLER tag. Then for every pair permutation and every filler pattern the NT31 induction gives z_h = c_h C[k_h] with c_h>0, so accuracy is exactly 1 with zero training. (c) CODE-SUBSPACE PARTITION CANNOT REPLACE THE BIT. Suppose we split C into two orthogonal row subspaces C_key, C_val, set A_t = C_key[x_(t-1)], b_t = C_val[x_t], w_t == 1 (no role information), and use any FIXED linear layer interface T. Then accuracy is strictly below 1 on the tight alternating layout. (d) NECESSITY IS LAYOUT-CONDITIONAL. With w_t == 1 and a TIGHT alternating layout, accuracy is below 1. With arbitrary filler spacing, filler tokens implicitly zero the spurious peak and accuracy can exceed 0.95. Therefore 'role information is necessary' must NOT be stated as an unconditional theorem. (e) The role tag acts on the INPUT SIGNAL only; every kernel remains static and Toeplitz, so FFT/IIR duality and O(1) state are preserved.
proof: Proof (a). The p-th key sits at absolute position s_p = sum_{q<p}(f_q+2) + f_p. Its successor is t_p = s_p + 1, and w_{t_p} = 1[(s_p) even]. Because f_p enters s_p additively and P(f_p odd) >= 1/2, the parity of s_p is independent of the pair permutation and of the answer k_h, and P(w_{t_p}=1) <= 1/2. Condition on the event w_{t_p}=0 (probability >=1/2): the h-th matching signal m_h[t_p]=0, so by NT31's base step with distinct keys the only remaining contributions are either zero (filler predecessors) or value-subspace codes orthogonal to q_h; in either case z_h is independent of k_h and the decoded answer is uniform on V_K, giving accuracy 1/V_K. Unconditionally, accuracy <= 1/2*1 + 1/2*(1/V_K) <= 1/2 + 1/(2 V_K). QED. Proof (b). Replace every occurrence of 'even index' in the NT31 induction by 'role(x_{t-1}) = KEY'. By P1 a KEY tag appears exactly once per pair, and by distinctness k_{h-1} tags exactly one pair, so the match is unique for ANY filler pattern. All other steps are verbatim. QED. Proof (c). In the tight alternating layout the symbol k_h occurs TWICE: as the VALUE of pair h-1 and as the KEY of pair h. Hence A_t = C_key[k_h] at two distinct positions t_a, t_b. Let T be any fixed linear layer interface and q_(h+1) = T(z_h). Case 1: q_(h+1) has zero inner product with C_key[k_h]; then m_(h+1) == 0 at both positions, z_(h+1)=0, and accuracy is chance. Case 2: the inner product is nonzero; then BOTH positions contribute, and z_(h+1) = K(t_a) C_val[w] + K(t_b) C_val[k_(h+1)], where w is the key of the pair adjacent to pair h-1 in the RANDOM permutation and is independent of k_(h+1). Because C_val[w] and C_val[k_(h+1)] are orthogonal, argmax selects k_(h+1) iff K(t_b) > K(t_a), an event determined by positions, not by the answer; over random permutations this fails with strictly positive probability. Hence accuracy < 1 for every fixed T. QED. Proof (d). Tight layout gives two nonzero peaks => (c) applies. In a gapped layout the token following a VALUE is a zero FILLER, whose b_t is the zero vector, so the spurious peak contributes nothing and only the true peak survives; accuracy can approach 1. Thus the necessity of the bit is a property of the LAYOUT, not a universal law. QED. Proof (e). w_t multiplies A_t = C[x_(t-1)], i.e. the input signal u_t. The impulse response K(d) is unchanged and depends only on the delay; Toeplitz holds, so a single FFT realizes the same operator as the IIR scan. The state is P vectors per layer, independent of L. QED. NON-VACUITY: n=4, V=64, VK=32, C = Sylvester Hadamard, f_p ~ Uniform{0..4}, H=2, H_L=2 satisfies P1-P4; (a) witnesses 0.3438 +/- 0.0314 (5 seeds), (b) witnesses 1.0000 on all four layouts, (c) witnesses 0.8691, (d) witnesses 0.8621 (none, tight) vs 0.9609 (none, gapped).
boundary: SCOPE. (i) This is a SUPPORTING LEMMA, not a 32nd headline theorem; the v5 main paper promotes exactly six core theorems. (ii) The upper bound in (a) is an expectation over the filler distribution, not a worst-case bound for every fixed filler pattern; a pattern with all keys at odd positions would give exactly chance, while one with all keys even gives 1. (iii) The 1-bit tag is minimal among SIDE-CHANNELS but we do NOT prove that no architecture outside P1-P4 (e.g. learned input-dependent gates, extra recurrence, or retaining intermediate outputs) could work without it. (iv) 'KEY / VALUE / FILLER' is a SYMBOL-TYPE annotation, not an answer leak: it does not reveal which key is queried or what k_H is. (v) Filler tokens are zero one-hots; their presence is itself structural information, which is precisely why (d) refuses an unconditional necessity claim. (vi) Synthetic content-chain task only; no LM claim. (vii) WITNESS CAVEAT: the first implementation of the (c) candidate used (A_prev @ Ck.T @ Ck), which is the projection Ck^T Ck rather than the key code. That bug was found and fixed; the recorded 0.8691 is from the corrected implementation and equals the no-role baseline, confirming the subspace partition adds nothing.
use: Converts the most damaging potential rejection ('the construction hides a task-format prior') into an auditable scope correction. Justifies withdrawal W9 and the H5 revision of NT31. Gives a concrete engineering rule: emit a role tag with each symbol (or use separate key/value symbol ids) instead of relying on absolute position parity. Also explains why the earlier 0.5918 two-layer result and the 0.8691 no-role baseline share the same root cause: role ambiguity, not capacity.
